# results/: which folders are current

**Quote numbers from `numbers.md` / `numbers.json`** (generated by `scripts/build_numbers.py`) or from the ledger `docs/EXPERIMENTS.md`,
not from folders directly. Status words: **current** = produced by the shipped system (Xception, seed 44, T = 0.35); **superseded** = kept
because something that stays was built from it or cites it, never quoted as a result; **experiment** = a diagnostic that shipped nothing.

`numbers.json` is what the app's Accuracy page shows. It is frozen for the submission; regenerating it changes at least
its "Generated" date on that page. Superseded results that nothing uses any more were removed on 28 Sep 2026.

## Current

| Folder / file | What it holds | Ledger |
|---|---|---|
| `numbers.json`, `numbers.md` | Every reported number, generated from the folders below | all |
| `heldout_eval_shipped/` | **Authoritative** four-condition evaluation on held-out video, with its threshold grid and bootstrap | F5 |
| `fallback_eval_shipped/` | Four-condition evaluation on the older set (in-distribution for the video model; comparison only); `threshold_tuning.json` is the T = 0.35 tuning that `scripts/fusion.py` cites | `docs/decisions/video_backbone_decision.md` s10 and s11 |
| `hybrid_eval_shipped/` | Four-condition evaluation with DeepfakeTIMIT fake video (the 0% video-naming boundary) | H2 |
| `lavdf_eval_shipped/` | Independent LAV-DF set, 200 clips | F6 |
| `cv/` | 5-fold identity-grouped cross-validation of the shipped architecture | V13 |
| `cross_method/` | Detection per manipulation method on unseen identities | V9, V10, V11, V14 |
| `cross_dataset/celebdf_v2__*` | Celeb-DF-v2 zero-shot for the finalists (`__mm_xcep_vidsplit` = shipped) | V12 |
| `runs/*_vidsplit/`, `runs/cv5_xcep_f*/` | Per-run, per-seed training and evaluation outputs on the corrected split | V8 to V14 |
| `summary/` | Per-variant aggregates, curves and bake-off tables on the corrected split | V8 to V14 |
| `audio_branch/` | Audio SVM on the full ASVspoof 2019 LA eval partition (`embeddings/` is a local cache) | A-series |
| `audio_baseline/` | MFCC + SVM against wav2vec2 + SVM, and the unseen-corpus false alarms | A3 |
| `calibration/` | Temperature-scaling check (shipped without scaling) | D3 |
| `preprocessing_parity/` | App input against evaluation input (JPEG round trip) | D4 |
| `ood_gate/` | Out-of-domain gate fit and evaluation (`features/` is a local cache) | O1 |
| `latency/latency.json`, `latency/app_end_to_end.json` | Per-stage latency and end-to-end app latency, 25 Sep | L3 |
| `llm_comparison/` | Llama 3 against Mistral and Qwen for the explanation | M1 |
| `explanation_eval_full/` | The 50-case packet, the two raters' sheets (raw copies with SHA256SUMS) and the scored results | E2 |
| `explanation_eval/` | The 16-case explanation pilot that came before it (it found the bug `explain.assess()` fixes; its sheets were never scored) | E1 |
| `ui_contrast_v4_final.json` | WCAG contrast of every text element in the final interface (`scripts/contrast_audit.py`) | |
| `logs/` | Job logs (local only); `logs/queues/` holds the output of the overnight queue launchers (`scripts/launchers/`) | |

## Experiments (diagnostics; nothing shipped)

| Folder | Question it answered | Ledger |
|---|---|---|
| `audio_channel_diagnostic/` | Is the unseen-corpus audio failure caused by codecs? (No) | A5 |
| `audio_encoder_comparison/` | Would WavLM beat wav2vec2? (No) | A6 |
| `audio_lavdf_experiment/` | Does adding LAV-DF speech fix the audio failure? (Adapts, does not generalise) | F7 |
| `lowres_diagnostic/` | Is LAV-DF's low resolution the cause? (No) | F6 addendum |

## Superseded (kept; never quote)

| Folder / file | Why it is kept |
|---|---|
| `runs/aug/` | The leaking-split EfficientNet-B4 runs: the 97.67% to 89.93% leak correction (report Chapters 1 and 6, Figure 5.1) |
| `latency/archive/` | The 21 Sep latency (9.02 s), measured before the out-of-domain gate and timing (L2). The ledger and TESTING_GUIDE cite it |

Removed on 28 Sep 2026 because neither the report nor the app uses them: the other leaking-split runs (`runs/reg/`, `runs/seed42/` to
`runs/seed44/`), the old-model evaluations (`fallback_eval/`, `hybrid_eval/`, `cross_dataset/celebdf_v2/`) and the unrated first explanation
packet (`explanation_eval_full_pre_timing_2026-09-21/`). The frozen `numbers.json` still holds their figures in sections the app never
shows (`baseline_legacy`, `reg`, `*_OLD_MODEL`); regenerating it with `scripts/build_numbers.py` leaves those sections empty.
